units.disclosure: Correctional Use - Location: a group home or a residential care home used for correctional purposes must be on a lot that is not in the RD zone. The regulated use is outside the modelled use and building-type vocabulary (group home / residential care home for correctional purposes), so no application subject token can be named; and the clause is a zone exclusion ('not in the RD zone'), which cannot be expressed as a positive application zone token nor as a lot condition (zones are not conditions). No numeric bound or DSL target arises.

Correctional Use - Location: a group home or a residential care home used for correctional purposes must be on a lot that has a front lot line abutting a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map. The regulated use is outside the modelled use and building-type vocabulary, so no application subject token can be named; the 'major street' test additionally depends on the Policy Areas Overlay Map (not an overlay code HT/ST/LC, and not held as geometry), so it cannot be written as mapped(...) or evaluated. No numeric bound or DSL target arises.
